t1.text: Trading Agent bot selector · three options (A recommended)

s1.text: DEC-263 says archived bots are not shown in the bot selector. Option A shows an Archived filter only because the brief asked for it; rows would open the read-only page. Needs a decision before code.

s2.text: Option B trade-off: the rail takes about 356 px. With the app sidebar, bot detail gets about 790 px at 1440 instead of about 1144 px, so charts and the decisions table get narrower. On phone it becomes the same bottom sheet as A.

s3.text: Phone: the top card is the selector and the bot header in one. Tap it to open the Switch bot sheet (BottomSheet, focus trapped). The red strip only shows when another bot needs attention.
